steps.how: sec.appendChild(node) on the 1776:8379 SECTION. Section children are positioned RELATIVE to the section, so set x/y AFTER the appendChild or the board lands 143,914px away — that is exactly the failure layout-section.mjs was written to clean up.
steps.place_why: Extends the existing y=220 group-expanded row rightwards rather than reordering live boards. Row y=220 is occupied at x=100/500/900/1300/1700/2100; the last board ends at x=2380 inside a 2480-wide section, so x=2500 and x=2900 are the next two free slots and the SECTION grows to accommodate them. Reordering the row into taxonomy order (default · elements · blocks · components · mine) is ARR-A-19's job, not this plan's — do not do both in one pass.
steps.readback: Re-read both nodes and assert parent.id === '1776:8379' and the absolute x/y land inside the section box.

steps.why: Six existing boards in 02 · Insert have no caption, and every new board needs one. The section's convention is a TEXT node named caption/<board name>, placed at the board's x and 832px below the board's y (measured: boards at y=220, captions at y=1052).
steps.spec: 11px / leading 16 / --bk-ink-muted #6B7280, textAutoResize HEIGHT, width 280 (380 for the modal boards).

captions.name: caption/Insert · elements-expanded
captions.text: ELEMENTS open — 53 rows, flat. Each row carries a written one-line description that the panel never shows: it reaches a tooltip only when the entry is disabled, and no catalog entry is (catalog/types.ts:12-14, GroupSection.tsx:186-187, catalog.ts:4) — UX-A-09; hover state on Insert · element-hover (description). Favourites are fully built and have no control anywhere: favs, toggleFav, favOpen, clearFavs, restoreFavs all live in useBuildTab.ts:104-168 behind BUILD_FAVORITES and BuildTab.tsx destructures none of them — UX-A-31; the ☆ toggle belongs on these rows. RECENTS ARE NOT BUILT — BUILD_RECENT (storageKeys.ts:59) is an orphan constant with zero consumers, so no recents band is drawn here (PHASE4-QA-REPORT §1.1). Reaching the group below costs 53 tab stops — UX-A-29.

captions.name: caption/Insert · blocks-expanded
captions.text: DESIGN-AHEAD. The one group drawn as a picture grid has no pictures: shared/types/block.ts:25 declares preview?: string and grep -rn preview packages/editor/src/blocks/ returns zero, so all 50 cards fall through to an empty 136x80 grey rectangle under an 11px label (GroupSection.tsx:234-262) — UX-A-05. Fifty blank rectangles are worse than fifty rows, so the shipping drawing is Insert · blocks-expanded · rows and this board is kept as the target for when previews exist. Cards are not draggable either — only ELEMENTS passes draggable — UX-A-06. Product Card / Product Grid / Product Detail open a CMS collection-setup modal on insert, unannounced and one-shot (useComposerInit.ts:735-763) — UX-A-28.

captions.name: caption/Insert · components-expanded
captions.text: COMPONENTS is the registry's 14 shipped component blocks (blockRegistry.ts:187-202). The user's own are under MINE, and the Components management tab is a third thing again — off the default rail, reachable only by ⇧A, the palette, or knowing it exists (tabsConfig.ts:151-170,349-351). One word, three meanings — UX-A-25. Rows carry no draggable — UX-A-06. The header count and the drawn list disagree: 14 is the code truth, so the list trims to fourteen (VIS-3-29).

captions.name: caption/Insert · mine-expanded
captions.text: MINE — the user's own saved components, loaded from composer.components and refreshed on COMPONENT_LIST_UPDATED (BuildTab.tsx:56-70). Search cannot reach them: searchInsert is passed catalog + blockRows + componentRows and never mine, and InsertSearchHit has no MINE case (useBuildTab.ts:235-238, utils/search.ts:16-26) — UX-A-11. Rows carry no draggable — UX-A-06. Empty state on Insert · mine-expanded · empty — today an empty MINE renders a header reading 0 over nothing at all — UX-A-24.

captions.name: caption/Modal · Add Child Element
captions.text: The canvas selection toolbar's + opens this, and it is a SECOND catalog: grouped by TYPE with Most Used / Recents / Favourites and per-element descriptions, reading the 64-entry registry directly, while the Insert panel groups by SOURCE off a hand-written 53-entry catalog — UX-A-03. It reports a success it has not had: useElementsState.ts:151-161 toasts "Added {label} to canvas" BEFORE calling the inserter, which then returns silently on a nesting / target / config failure and calls onClose() — UX-A-02. Refusal state on Modal · Add Child Element · refused.

captions.name: caption/Templates · empty
captions.text: STRANDED. This is the only Templates board filed under Insert; the rest of its async family (Templates · loading 778:4102, · load-error 781:4372, · no-results 782:4402) sits in section 1084:4527 · 11 · Templates. TEMPLATES is explicitly OUT of the Insert taxonomy — "template ka apna poora flow hai", founder-final 2026-08-07 (blocks/groups.ts:1-19), and buildInsertGroups() returns exactly four groups. ARR-A-18 asks for the move; it is the Templates module's call, not Insert's.

steps.also: Every board created by insert-new-boards.json needs its caption too; the caption text is the `why` + `decision` of its row in that plan.

steps.why: After the reparent and after add-state-board has added up to seven boards, the section needs one grid pass. layout-section.mjs measures its own pitch (GUTTER 120, PAD_X 100, PAD_TOP 220, MAX_PER_ROW 6), pairs captions to boards and shrink-wraps the section — which is exactly the arrangement work ARR-A-17/19/20 describe by hand.
steps.caution: MAX_PER_ROW defaults to 6. With 20 boards the section becomes ~4 rows. Run it ONCE, after all boards exist, not between steps.

renames.how: The count is CHILDREN, not frames — 13 frames + 9 captions = 22 today. After the move (+2 boards +2 captions), the seven new boards (+7 +7) and the six new captions (+6), the count is 22 + 4 + 14 + 6 = 46. Recount from the file rather than trusting this arithmetic.
